slices.focus: Mikayla gives Kelli a used air fryer that makes quick potatoes and reheats leftovers, reducing evening friction.
slices.summary: Mikayla passes along a used air fryer that becomes a small evening game-changer for Kelli — quick air-fryer potatoes, reheated burritos, and leftovers come together fast after dark commutes. Kelli notices the ripple effect on her evening mood and plans a simple index-card meal system. The slice captures a period of slightly more breathable life where small conveniences register as meaningful.
